headings: Finalized our Strategic Portfolio Review and Announced New Ingevity
paragraphs: Ingevity Corporation provides products and technologies that purify, protect, and enhance the world around us. Through a diverse team of talented and experienced people, we develop, manufacture, and bring to market solutions that are largely renewably sourced and help customers solve complex problems while making the world more sustainable. Our products are used in a variety of demanding applications, including automotive gasoline vapor emissions control systems, food, water and chemical filtration, asphalt paving, agrochemical dispersants, bioplastics, coatings, elastomers, and paint for road markings. We operate in three reportable segments: Performance Materials, Performance Chemicals and Advanced Polymer Technologies.

Throughout this Annual Report on Form 10-K, except where otherwise stated or indicated by the context, "Ingevity," the "Company," "we," "us," or "our" means Ingevity Corporation and its consolidated subsidiaries and their predecessors.

Our business originated as part of the operations of our former parent company, Westvaco Corporation, in 1964, and we operated as a division of Westvaco Corporation and its corporate successors, including MeadWestvaco Corporation and WestRock Company ("WestRock"), until our separation from WestRock in May 2016. Our common stock began "regular-way" trading on the New York Stock Exchange in May 2016 under the symbol "NGVT."

Our principal executive offices are located at 4920 O'Hear Avenue, Suite 400, North Charleston, South Carolina 29405. Ingevity maintains a website at www.ingevity.com. We make available, free of charge through our website, our filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC"), including our annual reports on Form 10-K, quarterly reports on Form 10-Q, current reports on Form 8-K and any amendments to those reports, as soon as reasonably practicable after such items are filed with, or furnished to, the SEC. We also use our website to publish additional information that may be important to investors, such as presentations to analysts. Information contained in or connected to our website is not incorporated by reference into this Annual Report on Form 10-K. Reports we file with the SEC may also be viewed at www.sec.gov.

On October 29, 2024, we announced our intention to comprehensively review Ingevity's asset and product portfolios, referred to as our Strategic Portfolio Review. On January 16, 2025, we announced the exploration of strategic alternatives for our Performance Chemicals industrial specialties product line, including a potential divestiture of portions of the North Charleston site. On September 4, 2025, we announced the agreement to sell the North Charleston crude tall oil refinery and the majority of the industrial specialties product line, and on January 1, 2026, the announced sale was completed.

On December 8, 2025, we announced the completion of our Strategic Portfolio Review. We labeled the state of the Company following the actions contemplated by the Strategic Portfolio Review, New Ingevity. To become New Ingevity, we announced the simplification of our businesses including the exploration of strategic alternatives for our Advanced Polymer Technologies ("APT") reportable segment and the Performance Chemicals road markings product line, which we expect to complete by the end of 2026. New Ingevity will be comprised of two attractive businesses aligned around strong core competencies, with superior and consistent profitability: Performance Materials and Pavement Technologies. New Ingevity's businesses will be focused on high-value, mission-critical applications that benefit from durable, long-term demand and will allow Ingevity to retain our global scale, maintain a strong pro forma financial profile, and provide a more stable, simplified specialty materials portfolio poised to deliver profitable growth with best-in-class earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization ("EBITDA") margins. We believe our two business segments are unified by very strong core competencies, including unique technologies that incorporate deep technical expertise on highly engineered materials, leading market positions, and intellectual property, all of which creates a sustainable competitive advantage for Ingevity.

On September 3, 2025, Ingevity entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement (the "Purchase Agreement") with Mainstream Pine Products, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("Purchaser"), pursuant to which Purchaser agreed to purchase substantially all of the assets and assume and acquire certain of the rights and liabilities of Ingevity or its applicable affiliates that relate to or are used in connection with (a) Ingevity's industrial specialties product line (other than Ingevity's lignin dispersant and alternative fatty acid based products, pavement technologies product line and other businesses and products more fully described in the Purchase Agreement) and (b) Ingevity's North Charleston, South Carolina crude tall oil refinery (the "CTO Refinery") and Ingevity's and its affiliates' operations thereof (collectively, the "Divestiture"). We determined that, upon execution of the Purchase Agreement, the industrial specialties product line and CTO Refinery included within the Divestiture met the criteria to be classified as held for sale and that the sale represents a strategic shift that will have a major effect on Ingevity's operations and results. As such, the results of operations of the Divestiture have been reclassified and presented as discontinued operations for all periods presented. The Divestiture was completed on January 1, 2026.

Unless otherwise noted, discussion within Part II relates to continuing operations. Refer to Note 20 of the Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements included in Part II. Item 8 within this Form 10-K for further information regarding discontinued operations.

There are a variety of seasonal dynamics, including global climate and weather conditions, that impact our businesses, though none have currently materially affected our financial results, except in the case of the pavement technologies and road markings product lines, where roughly 70 to 75 percent of revenue is generated between April and September. Furthermore, our Performance Chemicals pavement technologies and road markings product lines financial results can be sensitive to weather conditions, particularly prolonged or severe wet weather, which can disrupt operations, delay projects, and reduce customer demand across certain markets. From a supply perspective, this seasonality is effectively managed through pre-season inventory build and active inventory management throughout the year.

paragraphs: Based on the information currently known to us, we believe that the following information identifies the most significant risk factors affecting the Company. However, the risks and uncertainties we face are not limited to those set forth in the risk factors described below. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently believe to be immaterial may also adversely affect our business. In addition, past financial performance may not be a reliable indicator of future performance, and historical trends should not be used to anticipate results or trends in future periods.

If any of the following risks and uncertainties develop into actual events, these events could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition. or results of operations. In such case, the trading price of our Common Stock could decline.

Our review of strategic alternatives for the APT reportable segment and Performance Chemicals road markings product line may not result in a transaction and any transaction we enter into, including the completed sale of our North Charleston CTO refinery assets and the majority of the Performance Chemicals industrial specialties product line, may not yield the expected results or benefits.

On December 8, 2025, we announced plans to explore strategic alternatives for our APT reportable segment and Performance Chemicals road markings product line. While it is our intent to identify and pursue a transaction for each of APT and the road markings product line, that, in each case will improve the Company's financial performance and benefit our stockholders by enabling us to focus on higher margin opportunities, there can be no guarantee that this strategic review will result in such transactions or achieve such expected results or benefits.

We are dependent upon third parties for the provision of certain critical operating services, primarily utilities and related services (depending on the site, e.g., compressed air, energy, water, wastewater treatment, hydrogen peroxide), at our plants in Covington, Virginia, and Warrington, United Kingdom. We are co-located with third parties at each of the foregoing plants, and we face related risks of disruptions to our operations arising out of the acts or omissions of such third parties. We are also co-located with, and provide certain critical operating services to, a third party at our North Charleston, South Carolina plant. If we are unable to provide such services, we could face liability for disrupting such third party's operations.

The services provided by third parties would be at risk if any of the counterparties were to idle or permanently shut down the associated mill or plant, or if operations at the associated mill or plant were disrupted due to natural or other disaster, or by reason of strikes or other labor disruptions, or if there were a significant contractual dispute between the parties. The third party provider of critical and non-critical services at our location in Warrington, United Kingdom has discontinued most of its operations at its Warrington, United Kingdom plant, but continues to provide services to us. In the event that the applicable counterparty were to fail to provide the contracted services, we would be required to obtain these services from other third parties, most likely at an increased cost, or to expend capital to provide these services ourselves. The expenses associated with obtaining or providing these services, as well as any interruption in our operations as a result of the failure of the counterparty to provide these services, may be significant and may adversely affect our financial condition and results of operations.

paragraphs: Beginning in 2023, following a sharp decline in volumes in the industrial end markets served by our Performance Chemicals industrial specialties product line, we announced a series of strategic initiatives designed to right-size our cost structure, streamline our footprint, and strengthen the overall resilience of the Company. Collectively, these initiatives are referred to as the Performance Chemicals ("PC") Repositioning Actions.
The PC Repositioning Actions were designed to:
•Prioritize growth in our higher-margin Performance Chemicals product lines, such as pavement technologies;
•Improve the financial performance of the industrial specialties product line; and

•Reduce exposure to lower-margin, more cyclical end-use markets, including adhesives, publication inks, and oilfield applications, which historically represented approximately 45 percent of our industrial specialties product line's pre-2023 annualized net sales.

The actions completed through fiscal year 2024 successfully enhanced the financial performance of the industrial specialties product line and positioned that business for strategic alternatives. As a result, on January 16, 2025, we announced our intention to pursue a potential sale of the product line. On September 3, 2025, Ingevity entered into a sales agreement to sell substantially all of the assets, rights, and liabilities associated with the industrial specialties product line and the CTO refinery, (collectively, the "Divestiture"). Upon execution of the sales agreement, the industrial specialties product line and the CTO refinery included in the Divestiture met the criteria for classification as discontinued operations. As such, the results of operations of the Divestiture have been reclassified and presented as discontinued operations for all periods presented. The sale was completed on January 1, 2026.
PC Repositioning Status and Charges To Date

We have substantially completed all activities associated with the restructuring program and expect the plan to be completed in 2026. The PC Repositioning Actions restructuring program is expected to result in total charges of approximately $370 million, consisting primarily of:
•~$255 million in non-cash asset-related charges; and
•~$115 million in cash charges, including: ▪~$25 million in severance and other employee-related costs, and
▪~$90 million in other restructuring costs, including decommissioning, dismantling, and removal charges, and contract termination costs.
We expect to incur approximately $10 million of additional cash charges during 2026.

Through December 31, 2025, we have incurred $353.7 million in total charges, including $248.3 million of non-cash asset-related charges and $105.4 million in cash charges. As of December 31, 2025, we have paid $91.3 million of the cash charges.

paragraphs: Ingevity Corporation 提供用以淨化、保護與提升我們周遭環境的產品與技術。透過一羣多元且具才能與經驗的團隊，我們開發、製造並將解決方案帶入市場，這些解決方案主要來自可更新資源，並協助客戶解決複雜問題，同時使世界更加永續。我們的產品應用於多種嚴苛的應用情境，包括汽車汽油蒸氣排放控制系統、食品、水與化學過濾、瀝青鋪裝、農化分散劑、生物塑膠、塗料、橡膠與道路標線漆。我們經營三個應報告分部：性能材料、性能化學品與先進聚合物技術。
本年度報告書（Form 10-K）中，除非另有說明或根據上下文表示，"Ingevity"、"公司"、"我們"、"我們"或"我們的"均指 Ingevity Corporation 及其合併子公司與其前身。

我們的業務起源於我們前母公司 Westvaco Corporation 的運作，在 1964 年開始，我們作為 Westvaco Corporation 及其公司繼承者，包括 MeadWestvaco Corporation 與 WestRock Company（"WestRock"）的部門運作，直到 2016 年 5 月我們與 WestRock 分離。我們的普通股於 2016 年 5 月開始在紐約證券交易所以符號 "NGVT" 進行普通交易。

本公司主要營業據點位於南卡羅萊納州北查爾斯頓市奧赫耳大道 4920 號 400 號室，郵遞區號 29405。Ingevity 保有網站 www.ingenuity.com。本公司透過網站提供免費取得美國證券交易委員會（Securities and Exchange Commission，簡稱 SEC）所要求的申報文件，包括年度報告表 10-K、季報表 10-Q、現況報告表 8-K 以及這些報告的修正版本，於這些文件提交或提供給 SEC 後儘速公開。本公司亦透過網站發布對投資人可能重要的額外資訊，例如對分析師的簡報。網站內容或與網站連結之內容，並未被納入本年度報告表 10-K。本公司提交至 SEC 的報告亦可於 www.sec.gov 查閱。
2024 年 10 月 29 日，我們宣佈有意對 Ingevity 的資產與產品組合進行全面審視，稱為我們的戰略產品組合審查。2025 年 1 月 16 日，我們宣佈對我們的性能化學品工業專用產品線進行戰略替代探索，包括可能出售北查爾斯頓廠區的部分。2025 年 9 月 4 日，我們宣佈達成出售北查爾斯頓原油桐油煉油廠與該工業專用產品線的大多數，並於 2026 年 1 月 1 日完成出售。

2025 年 12 月 8 日，我們宣佈完成我們的戰略產品組合審查。我們將在戰略產品組合審查後的公司狀態標示為 New Ingevity。為成為 New Ingevity，我們宣佈簡化我們的業務，包括對我們的先進聚合物技術（"APT"）應報告分部與性能化學品道路標線產品線進行戰略替代探索，預計於 2026 年底完成。New Ingevity 將由兩個具有強大核心競爭優勢、具有優異且一致獲利能力的業務組成：性能材料與道路標線技術。New Ingevity 的業務將專注於高價值、關鍵任務應用，這些應用具有耐用且長期需求，將使 Ingevity 維持全球規模，維持強勁的預計財務狀況，並提供一個更穩定、簡化專利材料組合，以實現可持續的獲利成長與最佳等級的營業收入、稅前、折舊與 amortization（"EBITDA"）毛利率。我們相信我們的兩個業務分部由非常強大的核心競爭優勢所統合，包括獨特的技術，這些技術結合了對高度工程化材料的深入技術專業知識、領先市場地位與智慧財產權，這些都為 Ingevity 創造了可持續的競爭優勢。

2025 年 9 月 3 日，Ingevity 與 Mainstream Pine Products, LLC（一家德拉瓦州有限責任公司，"買方"）簽訂資產買賣協議（"買賣協議"），買方同意購買 Ingevity 或其適用子公司幾乎所有的資產，並承擔與取得 Ingevity 或其適用子公司與該資產相關的權利與義務（a）Ingevity 的工業專用產品線（不包括 Ingevity 的木素分散劑與替代脂肪酸基產品、道路標線技術產品線與其他更詳細說明於買賣協議中的業務與產品）以及（b）Ingevity 的南卡羅來納州北查爾斯頓原油桐油煉油廠（"CTO 燈廠"）與 Ingevity 及其子公司相關的運作（合稱為"出售"）。我們決定，在買賣協議簽訂時，出售中的工業專用產品線與 CTO 燈廠符合被歸類為待售資產的標準，且此出售代表一項戰略轉變，將對 Ingevity 的運作與結果產生重大影響。因此，出售的運作結果已重新歸類並作為已終止業務呈列於所有期間。出售於 2026 年 1 月 1 日完成。
除非另有說明，Part II 中的討論均與持續運作相關。請參閱 Part II 中包含於第 20 註解的合併財務陳述書附註。如需有關已終止業務的進一步資訊，請參閱本 Form 10-K 中的第 8 項。

有多種季節性因素，包括全球氣候與天氣條件，會影響我們的業務，不過目前尚無任何因素已顯著影響我們的財務結果，除了瀝青鋪裝技術與道路標線產品線，其中約 70 到 75％ 的營業收入是在 4 月至 9 月間產生。此外，我們 Performance Chemicals 瀝青鋪裝技術與道路標線產品線的財務結果會受到天氣條件的影響，特別是持續或嚴重的濕冷天氣，可能會干擾營運、延遲專案，並降低某些市場的客戶需求。從供應鏈的角度來看，這種季節性透過預季存貨建構與全年積極的存貨管理，已有效控制。

paragraphs: 自 2023 年起，由於我們 Performance Chemicals 工業專業產品線所服務的工業端市場體積出現顯著下降，我們宣佈了一系列戰略行動，旨在調整成本結構、簡化營運據點，並強化本公司整體的韌性。這些行動 collectively 被稱為 Performance Chemicals（"PC"）重整行動。
PC 重整行動的設計目標為：
• 優先發展我們高毛利率的 Performance Chemicals 產品線，例如路面技術；
• 提升工業專業產品線的財務表現；以及
• 減少對低毛利率、更具週期性終端市場的曝露，包括黏合劑、出版油墨及油田應用，這些市場歷來約佔我們工業專業產品線預 2023 年度淨銷售額的 45％。

截至財務年度 2024 年完成的行動，成功提升了工業專業產品線的財務表現，並為該業務的戰略選擇做好準備。因此，我們於 2025 年 1 月 16 日宣佈有意圖尋求將該產品線出售的潛在機會。2025 年 9 月 3 日，Ingevity 與買方簽訂銷售協議，出售與工業專業產品線及 CTO 製造廠相關的幾乎所有資產、權利及義務（合稱為 "出售"）。在簽訂銷售協議時，包含在出售中的工業專業產品線及 CTO 製造廠符合分拆營運的條件。因此，出售的營運結果已重新歸類並作為已終止營運項目呈現於所有期間。該出售於 2026 年 1 月 1 日完成。
PC 重整行動的進度與迄今為止的費用
我們已 substantially 完成與重整計劃相關的所有活動，並預期該計劃將於 2026 年完成。PC 重整行動的重整計劃預期將產生總計約 370 百萬美元的費用，主要由：
•~255 百萬美元之非現金資產相關費用；以及
•~115 百萬美元之現金費用，包括： ▪~25 百萬美元之資遣及其它員工相關費用，以及
▪~90 百萬美元之其它重整費用，包括停用、拆卸及移除費用，以及契約終止費用。
我們預期於 2026 年將再產生約 10 百萬美元之現金費用。

paragraphs: 根據目前我們所知的資訊，我們認為下列資訊識別出對本公司最重要的風險因素。然而，我們所面臨的風險與不確定性並不限於下列所列的風險因素。此外，尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前我們尚未知悉，或目前認為不重要，也可能對我們的業務產生不利影響。此外，過去的財務表現可能無法作為未來表現的可靠指標，歷史趨勢也不應用來預測未來期間的結果或趨勢。
若任何下列風險與不確定性發展成為實際事件，這些事件可能對我們的業務、財務狀況或營運成果產生重大不利影響。在此情況下，我們普通股的交易價格可能下跌。
本公司對APT應報告分部及Performance Chemicals道路標線產品線的戰略替代方案評估，可能不會導致交易發生，且任何我們進行的交易，包括已完成出售我們北查爾斯頓CTO煉油廠資產及Performance Chemicals工業專用產品線的大部分，可能不會產生預期的結果或效益。
於2025年12月8日，我們宣佈計畫探討本公司APT應報告分部及Performance Chemicals道路標線產品線的戰略替代方案。雖然我們的意圖是識別並追求對APT及道路標線產品線的交易，且在每種情況下，都能改善本公司的財務表現，並透過讓我們專注於高毛利率機會，使股東受益，但無法保證此戰略評估會導致這些交易，或達成預期的結果或效益。
我們依賴第三方提供某些關鍵營運服務，主要為電力及相關服務（視廠區而定，例如壓縮空氣、能源、水、廢水處理、過氧化氫），於維吉尼亞州科文頓及英國華靈頓的廠區。我們在上述廠區與第三方共用空間，因此面臨因第三方行為或疏忽而導致營運中斷的相關風險。我們也在南卡羅萊納州北查爾斯頓廠區與第三方共用空間，並為該第三方提供某些關鍵營運服務。若我們無法提供這些服務，可能會因中斷該第三方的營運而面臨責任。

若任何第三方提供的服務對手因故停止或永久關閉相關的磨坊或廠區，或因自然或其他災難、罷工或其他勞動中斷而導致相關磨坊或廠區營運中斷，或因雙方之間的重大契約爭議，則第三方提供的服務將面臨風險。位於英國華靈頓的第三方服務供應商已停止其在英國華靈頓廠區的大部分營運，但繼續為我們提供服務。若相關對手未能提供所約定的服務，我們將必須從其他第三方取得這些服務，很可能成本更高，或必須投入資本自行提供這些服務。取得或提供這些服務的費用，以及因對手未能提供這些服務而導致營運中斷所產生的影響，可能相當重大，並可能對我們的財務狀況及營運成果產生不利影響。
